periods.description: The Divine Drag-Ride Airi piloted in the final battle to support Lux. In vol-21 it is mainly referenced as the cause of her severe post-battle exhaustion, fever and muscle pain.

details.risk: heavy load on physically weak operator

periods.status: inactive after final battle / not to be worn again by Airi
history: Airi's decision to pilot it was essential to the victory over Fugil, but left her bedridden afterward.
